verdict.rationale: Replit's Agent is built around natural-language prompts for building, publishing, connecting integrations/MCP servers, and provisioning databases/auth, as documented extensively (e.g., docs-2, docs-21, docs-22, docs-31). Community evidence corroborates that users actively drive Replit via conversational 'vibe coding' commands, even though reliability varies (comm-6, comm-8).
